title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-10
source: Partial Show Source Info: Master Soundboard Reel > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10) > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Outstanding soundboard recording that sets a new standard for archival Dead shows
ai_review.review: The reviewer lauds the audio fidelity of this tape, saying it makes them wish earlier '68‑'70 concerts had been captured the same way. No musical details are provided, so the performance itself cannot be evaluated from this review alone.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic 5‑star review praises the recording quality; with no information on the musical performance, a neutral estimate is used for show quality, resulting in an overall rating around 3.6.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer emphasizes how great the recording sounds and wishes older shows could be captured like this, indicating a crisp, clear soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No comments on setlist or performance were provided in the review.
